$comment: EXP-1291 Threads v2: the THREAD screen ×4 (a thread IS a root session). Header = the title + ONE tab strip: Conversation · one issue chip per linked issue (session_issues of the ROOT by sortOrder; unsynced issues drop out) · '+' (link/file an issue; ALWAYS right after the issue chips) · the session chips (EXP-1316, below) · Guide (a dot while the root's guide holds any text or picture); nothing else (no captions, no Stop, no right sidebar). Phones use the strip as the pager. Conversation rows = the root's own session card first (session-card.json, ordinal 1), then the ROOT's messages oldest first (createdAt, ties by id): a card-less row = a message bubble (author user|agent|system, empty bodies skipped; a person's row reads `queued` until the device consumed it); card `session`/`thread_started` = that session's card (ordinal = its place in the tree's creation order; an unsynced target drops out); `question` (question, options, answer, answered = answeredAt set; EXP-1322: `card.options` = plain label strings and the parallel `card.optionDescriptions` sidecar carries the descriptions (same length; null or '' = none; the key is omitted when no option has one), so row option i = `{label: options[i], description: optionDescriptions?.[i] || null}`; a non-string option is dropped); the thread card renders label + description like the session view's card; the answer names the option by its label) and `plan` (plan, decision) answer IN the card; `subagent` (title, status); `picture` (attachmentId, width, height, caption; no attachmentId = dropped); `event` = one muted line from `copy.events` ({issue} = the issue's identifier, {pr} = '#<number>'; an unresolvable target or unknown event = dropped); unknown card kinds are dropped. Children's own messages never inline: they show when that session is opened. The composer below = THE session composer box (Composer primitive), placeholder `copy.placeholder`, sending `sessions.send({sessionId: root})` (an ended thread continues server-side in a new child). title = sessionTitle of the root (EXP-1341 session-title.json: the explicit name / agent CLI title, its issues, its action, its first prompt, `Untitled`). The server's `deriveSessionTitle` = the same function. private = !root.shared (a lock glyph beside the title). live/busy/needsYou aggregate the tree's non-ended sessions. Model = pure `buildSessionThread(input)` (packages/domain-contract/src/session-tree.ts), every mirror replays `cases` comparing the WHOLE expected object. EXP-1306 (owner 2026-10-14): the GUIDE tab ×4 = the root's Guide text over ONE pull request, `guidePullRequest(pullRequests)` (the root's pull_requests; every mirror replays `guidePullRequestCases`): the newest OPEN one (createdAt, ties by the higher number), else the newest MERGED one, else none (a closed PR never counts). When that PR sits in a linear open stack (pr-stack-view.json `stackView` over the repository's pull requests: head = branch, base = prBaseBranch) a `copy.stack` band (the pr-stack glyph, no count) + THE StackRail (top first, the PR's row = the current wash, down to its base branch; a row opens that PR's thread, the hovered/long-pressed row offers Merge through here) leads the Guide; no stack = no block. NO pull-request rows, no inline Merge, no Pull requests band. While the PR is open THE white bottom Merge capsule closes the tab (`testIds.guideMerge`; `Merge stack` on an open-stack member, the one stack confirm). The SESSION view (a session card opens it): while a question or plan card waits on the viewer the CARD takes the composer's place (EXP-820) ×4, the composer leaves and its draft comes back with it: `composerYieldsToCard({live, pendingAsk})` = live AND an unanswered question/plan the viewer may answer; every mirror replays `composerCases`. EXP-1307 (2026-10-14, EXP-1338: no GitHub entry, only the agent opens PRs): Close PR lives in ONE `…` (ui-more) in the thread HEADER's trailing slot ×4 (web/desktop: the title row's end; phones: the header's action slot), shown on every tab while it has an entry (EXP-1316, ×4) (`guidePullRequest`); `testIds.guideMenu` = the trigger. Its entries = `guideMenuEntries({state, member})` (state = that PR's state, null = no PR; every mirror replays `guideMenuCases`): `close-pr` (close-pr.json menuItem, pr-closed glyph, destructive) while the PR is open and the viewer is a member; Close confirms with close-pr.json's dialog (batchLine when the PR links other issues). Empty = no trigger. The bottom capsule stays Merge alone. EXP-1316 session chips: `tabs` carries `{kind: 'session', sessionId, name, markState}` after `add` and before `guide` = the sessions at the VIEWED level: on the thread = the root's own run, then its DIRECT children (tree creation order, createdAt then id); with `buildSessionThread(input, {focus})` (cases carry `options.focus`) = that session first (the active chip), then ITS direct children; nothing deeper. `focusId` = the focused session (null = the thread). name = sessionCard's name = that session's sessionTitle (EXP-1341; a child's issues = the ones ASSIGNED to it); markState = sessionTabMarkState = threadRowMarkState({needsYou, busy}) of THAT session, `ended` once it ended. Every chip in the strip is ONE height (entity-chip.json tab size). Clicking a session chip or a session card opens the session IN PLACE on web md+ and the IDE (`?tab=session&session=<id>` on the thread route; `/sessions/$sessionId` stays a redirect for deep links): the header + strip stay, the body = the raw work, the header's trailing slot gains its Stop pill while live; EXP-1343 (owner 2026-10-17, AMENDS the phone push): phones page through EVERY strip tab (conversation · issue chips + their nested issues · session chips + their nested sessions · guide; `+` is never a page) by swipe AND tap, in strip order; a session page = the raw work + its composer under the SAME thread header band + strip (ONE header for every page; the trailing slot gains the session's Stop while live); only the visible page holds live models (neighbours render cheap, a page left disposes its models). Hover (md+/IDE) or long-press (phones) on the session group = the tree popover (list-item.json SessionRow small rows + TreeGuides, the whole tree, the current row washed). EXP-1316 embedded issue: the issue tab = the issue body WITHOUT its own header bar, mobile header, Threads row, Start control or pin (title row, properties, description, files, relations, activity + comments stay; the phone bottom bar keeps properties + Comment only). EXP-1316 phone header: the thread screen wears detail-chrome.json's header band (blur + scrim + edge fade, content scrolls under it): `‹` · the title on ONE line (not tappable) + the lock · `…`, the strip (the pager) inside the band. Phones' reply box = THE floating composer capsule (collapsed: a capsule reading `copy.placeholder` floating over the content above the bottom edge fade; tap expands it into THE Composer card: text, + images/files, send, Stop while busy; collapses on blur), the session view uses the same component; web md+/IDE keep the in-flow Composer box. EXP-1316 header merge (amends EXP-1306/1307 on web md+ and the IDE): while `guidePullRequest` is open the header's trailing slot = the Merge pill (`Merge PR` | `Merge stack`), then the Stop pill while the focused session is live, then the `…` (every tab ×4, see EXP-1307); phones keep the white bottom Merge capsule on the Guide tab. EXP-1316 one card: `question` and `plan` rows render THE session view's card ×4 (the same component and answer path, `sessions.answer`): a question offers its options AND a free-text answer (`custom: true`; `answer` may be any string, not only an option), a plan its decision + note; the thread draws no reduced card of its own. An answered card renders CLOSED (chosen answer / decision shown, options inert) on every client whichever path answered it: the thread card (`sessions.answer`) or the session view (relay → device → `sessions.resolveCard`). `sessions.resolveCard({messageId, answer?, decision?, feedback?})` = the DEVICE's write-back (its owner's token, the same steer auth as `answer`): stamps the same answered `card` + `answeredAt` while still null, `{ok: true}` idempotently when already answered (never CONFLICT), and enqueues nothing: the engine resolved that question itself, so the card left the engine's open cards (`outbox.resolve_question`) and the pickup, which only feeds answered cards still OPEN in the engine, never re-feeds it. DISPATCH (owner 2026-10-15, thread 2eb4b1a1): every new root (thread or team agent, `sessions.dispatch`) is a dispatcher on the device's thread model that answers shallow questions itself and starts child sessions for real work; its composer = THE session composer of the session view ×4 targeting the ROOT: text, + (files), Send ⇄ Stop while the tree is busy, the model pin (ONE model picker, all four models, no Default; a pick sends `/model <alias>` through `sessions.send`), the context ring off the root's relay state, the `/` menu (steerCommands ∪ agent commands); NO queue strip on the thread (the person's queued rows already show in the Conversation with their Remove X, EXP-1317); NO plan chip/toggle on a dispatcher (plan mode is a work pick for its children). Placeholder `copy.placeholder`. EXP-1317 queue: a person's OWN queued row (queued = true, authorId = the viewer) carries ONE `Remove from queue` X ×4 (the ui-close glyph, tooltip `Remove from queue`, `sessions.unqueue`); its tooltip never outlives the button (the IDE keys the button on (message id, queued) and drops the tooltip when the row flips). EXP-1323 (owner 2026-10-15): a `report` card {sessionId, summary} (a child's end, posted on its PARENT, agent-authored) = an event-like row `copy.report` with {session} = that session's card name + the summary (card.summary, else the body); an unsynced session drops it. A `suggestions` card {items:[{id,title,text,issueIds?,sessionId?,issueId?,here?,dismissed?}]} (`exponential_sessions_suggest`) = ONE row: dismissed items drop (all dismissed = no row); item state = started (sessionId; `card` = that child's SessionCard once synced, else null) > here (Do it here) > filed (issueId; identifier when synced) > open; header = `copy.suggestions.one|many`, plus ` · ` + `started` with any started; `startAll` = more than one open item. The card renders in THE DecisionCard/Work card styling: open items = title, text, × (Dismiss), Options (THE Menu: Start on… · Start with… · File as issue · Dismiss), Do it here, Start; phones stack the buttons. Message rows carry `authorSessionId` (absent = null). `liveSessionId` = the root while it is not ended: the Conversation ends with THE Queue (fixtures/task-queue.json `taskQueue()`, EXP-1324: the same block as the raw view's transcript bottom, never the Work card tasks variant) + ONE status line read from that session's relay state, above the composer. A `/btw` aside is a plain child `session` card on the parent (title = the question, caption = the answer's first line). EXP-1347 (owner 2026-10-17) chip navigation ×4 = the INNERMOST outlet: an issue pill (#IDENT, issue chip, card chip) tapped anywhere inside a thread (its Conversation, an embedded session, a card) whose issue is one of THAT thread's issue tabs (chip or nested) selects that tab, never leaving the thread; else desktop focuses an existing top tab holding it, else opens a new top tab; phones/web push the issue. EXP-1334 (owner 2026-10-16, AMENDS EXP-1316's strip, row 0 and the session chips): the conversation IS the dispatcher: NO root session chip, NO root card first. `tabs` = `add` (the '+', LEFT of Conversation: THE Menu Link an issue > THE search list, New issue ×4) · conversation · issue chips · session chips · guide; nothing scrolls: + and Conversation pinned left, Guide pinned right. Issue chips = the TOP-LEVEL linked issues (root sortOrder); a linked issue whose nearest LINKED ancestor (TreeIssue.parentId, walking past unlinked ones; a cycle = top-level) exists folds under it: `nested` [{issueId, identifier, depth}] depth-first, depth relative to the chip. Session chips = the dispatcher's DIRECT children (tree creation order), every deeper session folded: `nested` [{sessionId, name, markState, depth}]; `focus` no longer changes the chips. A chip with `nested` wears a chevron-down and a CLICK (every platform, no hover, no long press) opens THE Menu (phones: the bottom sheet): row 1 = the chip itself, then the nested rows as THE tree rows (SessionRow small + TreeGuides for sessions; issue rows for issues); the chip is active while it or a nested one is open, reading `<chip> › <open one>`. The strip between Conversation and Guide = `partitionThreadStrip` (every mirror replays `stripCases`): everything full → issues identifier-only → fold, the sessions keeping their own room (what the short issues leave, at least half), each zone with its own '+N' (THE Menu of the hidden chips). Rows: a CHILD's own `question`/`plan` card (any session of the tree but the root) surfaces in the Conversation by createdAt, THE same card, answered in place (`sessions.answer`, straight back to that child); question/plan rows carry `sessionId`; children's other messages still never inline. The composer = THE session composer, placeholder `Type / for commands`. Phones (the pager: web-mobile, iOS, Android): Conversation and Guide are ICON-ONLY tabs (action-chat, guide-changes; the label stays the accessible name, the Guide dot stays), so the middle zones keep their room; md+ and the IDE keep icon + label. EXP-1280 (custom plan mode, plan-card.json): `plan` rows gain `questions` [{id, prompt, multi, custom (default true), options:[{label, description, attachmentId}]}] (a question without a string id/prompt, or an option without a string label, drops; an option's picture = its `picture` label resolved through the card's `pictures`, unresolved = null), `surface` ({root, data} when `root` is an object, else null), `answers` ({id: string labels} or null), `feedback` (non-empty string or null), `surfaceData` (the surface's data model as answered: a JSON object, else null); `question` rows gain `multi`, `custom` (false only when the card says so), `surface`, `answers` (string labels or null), `surfaceData` and their options an `attachmentId` (the `optionPictures` label sidecar resolved through `pictures`). Both render THE rich card of plan-card.json. EXP-1211 quick replies: a `replies` card {items:[{id, text, sent?}]} (MCP `sessions_suggest` `replies`) is NEVER a Conversation row; `composerReplies(messages, sessionId)` (every mirror replays `repliesCases`) = the session's NEWEST replies card (createdAt, then id) minus its `sent` items as {messageId, items:[{id, text}]}, null when none is left (a newer card replaces an older one even when the newer is all sent). It renders as ONE row of action Pills (sm; GlassPill on the natives) directly above THE session composer, thread and raw session view alike, wrapping on md+/desktop and scrolling sideways on phones, with a trailing dismiss icon button (concept `ui-close`, label `copy.replies.dismiss`); hidden whenever the composer is (the ask dock). A tap = `sessions.sendReply` (the text as the next message, at once even mid-turn, the chip drops), dismiss = `sessions.dismissReplies`.
